cor:bessel-relation: Original Corollary3.4, source891–897, original PDF22. An optional specialized Bessel-kernel connection mentioned in the introduction; it is not part of the generic-monodromy confluence proof.
cor:local-limit-of-rational-solutions: Original Corollary2.4, source530–537, original PDF13. Optional independent Maclaurin-series rational special case; not a premise of the RH proof of Theorem1.4.
eq:u-n-leading: Original equation(8.8), source3052–3060, original PDF69. A later small-x consequence, mentioned only in a rational-specialization check; not used to establish generic confluence.
eq:u-n-zero-rational: Original equation(2.19), source501–505, original PDF13. Optional rational-solution product expression mentioned in the introduction.
sec:Frobenius-method: Original Section2, source359–537, original PDF10–13. Separate Maclaurin-series route for initial conditions analytic/nonzero at0; the generic-monodromy proof uses retained Sections4–7 and9.1–9.2.
sec:Umemura: Original Section3, source540–952, original PDF14–23. Separate Umemura-polynomial applications, not generic confluence core.
sec:prop-1-proof: Original Section8, source2888–3072, original PDF66–69. Later small-x asymptotic consequence. No proof dependency of the selected generic confluence theorem.
thm:$D_6$-$D_8$-series: Original Theorem2.1, source471–481, original PDF12. Separate local Maclaurin-series result mentioned as motivation; not an assumption in the retained generic RH proof.

figure_label_transcription.source_portions: Native author blocks unchanged; 83 literal graphic labels transcribed separately, with editorial locators outside author labels.

source_notation_resolution.note: Original Figure10 prints E_0, while the author verification of its circle jumps explicitly uses the defined E^0 in both full matrix identities at source2351–2355, tied to definitions1204–1218. Both printed forms remain literal. No editor identity E_0=E^0, no figure correction, and no claim of author correction is made.

retained_original_metadata.title: Generic-monodromy Painlevé-III D6 to D8 confluence of even and odd Bäcklund iterates
retained_original_metadata.source_version: Official SIGMA 20 (2024) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
retained_original_metadata.difficulty_reason: The complete confluence argument builds both local parametrices, matches monodromy and controls the limiting Riemann–Hilbert error. It then proves solvability and the even/odd reciprocal involution.
retained_original_metadata.author: Ahmad Barhoumi; Oleg Lisovyy; Peter D. Miller; Andrei Prokhorov

proof_review.note: Source fidelity, author-core completeness and strict difficulty screening only; not independent mathematical refereeing The complete confluence argument builds both local parametrices, matches monodromy and controls the limiting Riemann–Hilbert error, then proves solvability and the even/odd reciprocal involution.
